neighbours.label: the word ' dose' in drug or exposure dosing contexts (dose range, dose used, dose-response)
fire: Patients in the second group received a higher dose of the drug for six weeks.
Researchers measured how the blood level changed across the whole dose range.
The recommended dose for adults is two tablets taken with food.
In the trial, a single dose of the vaccine produced a strong immune response.
The vet adjusted the dose because the dog weighed less than expected.
Radiation workers wear badges that record the total dose they absorb each month.
Doubling the dose did not improve symptoms but increased side effects.
The study found a clear dose-response relationship between smoking and risk.
quiet: Patients in the second group received the drug for six weeks instead of four.
Researchers measured how the blood level changed over the whole treatment period.
The recommended way to take it is with food and a full glass of water.
In the trial, the vaccine produced a strong immune response in older adults.
The vet changed the medicine because the dog weighed less than expected.
Radiation workers wear badges that record where they work each month.
Switching the drug did not improve symptoms but increased side effects.
The study found a clear link between smoking and the risk of heart disease.

notes: card: ' dose' x7 and 'ose' x3 in top 32; also spaces before quantities ('around 390 parts per million'). Output direction suppresses dose/concentration tokens.
